note: Confirm every rate against the Finance Act and the current NSE and BSE charge circular before a position-size calculation. This file is a reviewed snapshot, not a broker contract note.

items.label: STT equity delivery, buy
items.source: Delivery STT is charged on both sides. Re-verify the 0.1% rate in the Finance Act at each review.

items.label: STT equity delivery, sell
items.source: Delivery STT is charged on both sides. Re-verify the 0.1% rate in the Finance Act at each review.

items.label: STT equity intraday, sell side
items.source: Intraday equity STT is charged on the sell side. Re-verify the rate at each review.

items.label: STT equity and index futures, sell side
items.source: Reported Budget change from 0.02% to 0.05% effective 1 April 2026. Confirm the Finance Act text.

items.label: STT options, sell side on premium
items.source: Reported Budget change from 0.1% to 0.15% of premium effective 1 April 2026. Confirm the Finance Act text.

items.label: STT options, exercise
items.source: Reported Budget change from 0.125% to 0.15% effective 1 April 2026. Confirm the Finance Act text.

items.label: GST on brokerage and exchange transaction charges
items.source: GST at 18% on brokerage and on exchange transaction charges. GST is not charged on STT.

items.label: Stamp duty
items.source: Stamp duty is set by the state and charged on the buy side. Do not apply one national rate.
